These are real Google Civic Information API responses captured on October 12, 2026 with the configured GOOGLE_CIVIC_API_KEY. `captures.json` records the route, response status, public government office address and SHA-256. The key and key-bearing request URLs are never saved. The raw public-office normalized input is retained only in these source fixtures and routine public-office evidence; reader address lookups discard it.

`elections.json` identifies election 12000, the November 3, 2026 general election. Arizona, Michigan and Virginia have published site or contest rows. California, North Carolina and Texas returned successful responses with no requested rows. New Hampshire and New Jersey returned HTTP 404; the New York public-office address returned HTTP 400. These responses describe those addresses at capture time and do not establish a state's complete coverage or a missing ballot.

The API may omit district OCD IDs, candidate names and publication timestamps. Fixtures preserve those omissions. Tests keep rows with no native join and test native OCD joins separately using an explicitly modified test input. No modified input is represented as a real provider capture. Runtime code never loads these fixtures.
